## Summary

A brief description of the feature you'd like.

## Motivation

Why is this needed? What problem does it solve or what workflow does it improve?

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you considered and why you prefer this one.

## Additional context

Links, related issues, or anything else that might be helpful.
